title: Why we need an AI-resilient society
abstract: arXiv:1912.08786v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Three generations of software have transformed the role of artificial intelligence in society. In the first, programmers wrote explicit logic. In the second, neural networks learned programs from data. In the third, large language models turn natural language itself into a programming interface. These shifts reach far beyond computer science, reshaping how societies generate knowledge, make decisions, and govern themselves. While generative adversarial networks introduced the era of deepfakes and synthetic media, large language models have added a new class of systemic risks. translated_title: 为什么我们需要一个能抵御人工智能的社会
translated_abstract: arXiv:1912.08786v3 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：三代软件已经改变了人工智能在社会中的角色。第一代中，程序员编写显式逻辑。第二代中，神经网络从数据中学习程序。第三代中，大型语言模型将自然语言本身转化为编程接口。这些转变远远超出了计算机科学的范畴，重塑了社会如何生成知识、做出决策和进行自我治理。虽然生成对抗网络引入了深度伪造和合成媒体的时代，但大型语言模型增加了新型系统性风险。本报告采用法医心理学画像方法，基于九个已记录的特征来刻画人工智能：幻觉、偏见和毒性、谄媚和回音室效应、捏造和轻信、无理解的知识、不连续性和无法从经验中学习、参差不齐的智能和扩展限制、捷径和欺诈。
tldr: 本文通过法医心理学方法分析人工智能的九大风险特征，强调社会需建立抵御AI的系统性能力，以应对其对社会知识生成和治理的深层影响。
en_tdlr: This report profiles AI's nine documented risk features using forensic psychology, emphasizing the need for society to build resilience against AI's systemic impacts on knowledge and governance.
